_comment: Optara deployment config for monad-testnet (DEPLOYMENT.md §2-§3). Role addresses are the multisigs/timelock and MUST be filled in before deploying; Deploy.s.sol refuses zero addresses. pyth: verified on-chain 2026-10-07 (getUpdateFee, MON/USD feed). kuruRouter: Kuru's own testnet Router (owned by Kuru; deployProxy is permissionless here), checked by test/fork/KuruAdapter.fork.t.sol against testnet.

redstone._comment: RedStone pull prices (redstone-primary-prod): the signers LiveSpotOracle accepts and how many distinct ones a feed needs. Signer list from RedStone's SDK (getSignersForDataServiceId), checked 2026-10-12 against live payloads.

fees._comment: Protocol fee rates every listing applies (FeeController.setFeeRates, governance): the writer's open fee is a share of the minted mark, the buyer's a share of the premium spent through the router. 30 bps = 0.3%, as the docs state; the contract's built-in default is 300 bps (3%).
